findings.summary: Minus signs on fund figures look like losses and scare the reader away.
The recommended account is an unfamiliar company, not a bank.
The bar colours are explained in a separate key, so the reader had to look back and forth, and the colours are similar.
The same caveat repeats in every bank row and had to be reread.
The dark background and many numbers are tiring.
The 7% yearly return looks like a promise.
Small pale grey text above the bank list is hard to read.
English letters and jargon (MSCI, ETF, נאמן, etc.).
